attributes.action: LET’S MAKE FIREWORKS BEAUTIFUL, NOT TERRIFYING
attributes.additional_details:
Dogs tremble & hide. Horses panic & can injure themselves. Distressed cattle. Animals refuse to eat, won’t go outside & can remain frightened long after the fireworks have stopped. 
Imagine being an animal that doesn’t understand what is happening, hearing repeated explosions with nowhere safe to escape.
Why should animals suffer as humans enjoy a few minutes of explosive noise.
We aren’t asking for celebrations to end. Technology gives us the opportunity to produce silent spectacular displays.
attributes.background:
We are calling on the UK Government to phase out loud, explosive fireworks available to the general public and move towards genuinely zero noise and no-bang alternatives. 
Why does this matter?
Every year, countless animals suffer because of fireworks.

rejection.details:
We have a petition that has opened very recently which calls for what your petition is seeking. You may wish to sign it.

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
